description: This file contains utility classes and functions for handling HTTP request parameters, headers, and AWS Bedrock model ID encoding. It defines helper methods for merging query parameters, forwarding request headers, and encoding ARNs in endpoint URLs, specifically tailored for use with AWS Bedrock endpoints.

classes.name: BasePassthroughUtils
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage query parameters and headers for request forwarding.

classes.name: CommonUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility functions for encoding AWS Bedrock modelARNS in endpoint URLs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Union[str,List[str]]] get_merged_query_parameters( existing_url: httpx.URL, request_query_params: Dict[str, Union[str, list]] )
methods.description: Merges existing URL query parameters with additional request query parameters, prioritizing existing ones.

methods.name: forward_headers_from_request( request_headers: dict, headers: dict, forward_headers: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Forwards headers from an original request, optionally merging with custom headers while excluding certain headers.

methods.name: str encode_bedrock_runtime_modelid_arn(endpoint: str)
methods.description: Encodes slashes in AWS Bedrock ARNs within endpoint strings to prevent path parsing issues, handling specific resource patterns.
